name.zh: 示例插件：目标表面摘要

description: Reference plugin for the InkBlade plugin SDK. Records the assessment target, the run marker and the declared scope without opening a network connection, then emits one informational finding plus a JSON artifact. Use it as the baseline for read-only collectors.

params_schema.target: in-scope target identifier or URL, echoed back in the artifact
params_schema.note: free-form operator note stored in the artifact
